events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Sir Mick Jagger, a true rock and roll icon.

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed the game forever. From 'Video Killed The Radio Star' to shaping generations of artists, what was your favourite music video era?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music and Art Fair, a pivotal event in music history, kicked off on this day in 1969, bringing '3 Days of Peace & Music' to half a million people.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. A truly iconic moment that defined a generation. What's your favourite live performance from the festival?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on the anniversary of his passing. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders' Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock powerhouse and the enduring voice of The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The legendary Oasis frontman and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Britpop Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and those unmistakable vocals. What's your favourite Liam track, solo or Oasis?

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to thrilling espionage, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary musician and co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring spirit of John Lennon. Imagine the music he might still be making.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the endlessly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.
